name: Image Studio
pitch: Upload, describe, and re-render on your own box.
description: Chain read, think and render steps across the models you actually have installed. Upload a png and have a vision model describe it, re-render it with a change, refine a plate over several passes, or restyle it with another model from the shelf. The Tiiny has no image-to-image path, so a chain that starts from a photo paints a new plate rather than editing the old one, and the app says so next to the result instead of pretending otherwise. jpeg and webp are refused with a sentence, because png is what this decodes without a platform converter. One inference at a time, since that is what the hardware does. The rail shows NPU units used and free and greys out a model that will not fit. The gallery lives outside the install directory, so a farm update does not throw your plates away.
